groups.description: Participant received a single dose of TPIP 112.5 μg via oral inhalation on Day 1. The participant then entered into a 16-week EUT Period during which TPIP, administered via oral inhalation, was titrated up to a mean daily dose of 320 μg.
groups.title: Treprostinil Palmitil Inhalation Powder (TPIP)

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The study was terminated by the Sponsor due to low enrolment. As only 1 participant was enrolled in this study, no data is reported here, in order to protect and maintain participant privacy/confidentiality.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Number of Participants Who Experience a Treatment Emergent Adverse Event (TEAE)
